info.title: Get Affiliate Campaign Creator Product Content Statistics
info.description: Get statistics on creator's marketing video content

get.summary: Get Affiliate Campaign Creator Product Content Statistics
get.description: Get statistics on creator's marketing video content

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The partner access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 3. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3978f4c20311b8b555) to get partner access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: affiliate_product_id
parameters.description: The affiliate product identifier to be included in the response. Refer to `promotion_creators.affiliate_product_id` in the response of Get Affiliate Campaign Creator Fulfillment Status Info gateway.

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description:
Content type.Identify content as video or live.
- 1: VIDEO
- 2: LIVE_ROOM

parameters.name: category_asset_cipher
parameters.description: The partner identifier used in API requests. Retrieve this value by using the [Get Authorized Category Assets API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/666012dd609d4402cc3be995).

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

content_type.description:
Content type.Identify content as video or live.
- 1: VIDEO
- 2: LIVE_ROOM

cover_img_url.description: A URL for the live room cover image in the TikTok CDN.The video content doesn't have this value.

source_url.description: The URL on the public TikTok website at which the live room video can be played back. When content_type == VIDEO, the value is the url of the source video; when content_type == LIVE_ROOM, the value is the url where you can play back the recording of the live.

view_count.description: The number of public views of the live room or video.

like_count.description: The number of TikTok user likes associated with the live room or video.

comment_num.description: The number of TikTok user comments associated with the live room or video.

paid_order_num.description: The total number of paid orders associated with the live room or video.

paid_amount.description: The aggregate value of product orders associated with the live room or video.

linked_tiktok_video.description: The friendly URL for the video on the TikTok website.

published_date.description: When content_type == VIDEO, this is the date when the video was published; when content_type == LIVE_ROOM, this is the date when the live started. The value is in YYYY_MM_DD format.

content_end_date.description: When content_type == VIDEO, this field is None; when content_type == LIVE_ROOM, this is the date when the live ended. The value is in YYYY_MM_DD format.

creator_content_statistics.description: A list of objects that represent content statistics for the associated creator.
